title: carduus tmoleus subsp. armatus
intro: Carduus tmoleus subsp. armatus, commonly known as Armed Thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is a type of thistle with thorny, prickly leaves and stems. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Armed Thistle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
